copy.heroTitle: A bakery POS software built for retail counters and custom cakes.
copy.heroDescription: Sell fresh breads and pastries at counter speed, configure cake sizes, record custom celebration messages and track advance pickups. RestaBee provides bakeries with clean, dependable bakery POS software.
copy.menuScreenCaption: Retail counter items, cake size variants, custom notes and instant checkout on the POS screen.
copy.overviewTitle: Keep bakery counter sales moving quickly.
copy.overviewParagraphOne: Bakeries manage two distinct sales workflows every day: fast retail sales of cookies, breads and pastries across the glass counter, alongside custom celebration cakes that require advance booking, size selection and specific decorating instructions.
copy.overviewParagraphTwo: A dedicated bakery pos software lets cashiers ring up over-the-counter baked items in seconds. Staff select items, choose portion sizes or weights, record cash or UPI payments and hand the customer a printed receipt without keeping the next customer waiting.
copy.overviewParagraphThree: RestaBee functions as an easy-to-use bakery pos system designed for retail bakeries, patisseries and cake shops. By combining quick counter billing with custom cake order tracking, your staff manage both walk-in sales and advance orders in one tidy register.
copy.serviceTitle: Tailored for retail bakeries and cake shops.
copy.serviceDescription: Manage ready-to-eat counter sales, advance celebration cake bookings and packaged confectioneries in one point of sale.
copy.customOrderTitle: Configure cake weights and custom writing.
copy.customOrderDescription: Offer standard cake sizes like 500g and 1kg, and record customized celebration messages directly on the order ticket.
copy.customOrderParagraphOne: Celebration cakes come in standard portion sizes, such as half kilogram, one kilogram or two kilograms. In this bakery billing software, cashiers tap a cake item to view its configured size variants, with the price updating automatically for each size.
copy.customOrderParagraphTwo: Special instructions like Happy Birthday Rahul or Eggless preparation stay attached to the order line. When staff punch an advance order, the bakery decorating counter receives a clear order ticket listing the cake flavor, weight, custom message and pickup date.
copy.customOrderParagraphThree: Clear custom order tickets prevent spelling errors on birthday cakes and ensure customer requests are followed precisely. This straightforward setup makes RestaBee a practical pos for bakery staff managing custom celebration orders.
copy.workflowTitle: The bakery sales and pickup cycle.
copy.workflowDescription: Follow a bakery sale from over-the-counter selection to custom cake booking and scheduled customer pickup.
copy.handoffParagraphOne: In bakeries with an on-site pastry kitchen, ready items are picked directly from display shelves while custom cakes route to the decorating table. RestaBee routes custom cake tickets to the decorating station printer so pastry chefs prepare celebration cakes ahead of the scheduled pickup.
copy.handoffParagraphTwo: When the customer arrives to collect their cake, cashiers locate the advance order by customer name or token reference. The cashier verifies the completed cake, settles any remaining balance and marks the order collected.
copy.handoffParagraphThree: This dependable handoff makes RestaBee an effective bakery pos software for busy cake shops during weekend rush hours. Cashiers and decorators share order visibility, preventing misplaced pickup boxes.

copy.reportDescription: Track revenue by product category, monitor top-selling pastries and reconcile cashier shift drawers accurately at closing time with your bakery pos software.

faqs.question: What is a bakery POS software?
faqs.answer: A bakery POS software is point of sale software designed for bakeries and cake shops. It combines rapid counter billing for retail baked goods with custom cake size selection, celebration message notes and advance order pickup tracking.

faqs.question: Can I configure cake sizes like half kg and one kg?
faqs.answer: Yes. Menu items in the bakery pos software can have configured weight or portion variants, such as 500g and 1kg, each with its own price. Cashiers select the requested size during order entry.

faqs.question: Can cashiers enter custom writing for birthday cakes?
faqs.answer: Yes. Staff can type custom celebration messages and notes (such as Happy Birthday Aisha or eggless) directly into the item line, which prints on the kitchen decorating slip.

faqs.question: Does RestaBee support advance orders for future pickup?
faqs.answer: Yes. Staff can record advance orders with customer contact details and scheduled pickup dates so the pastry counter prepares celebration cakes ahead of time.

faqs.question: Does RestaBee manage industrial dough manufacturing or raw ingredient recipes?
faqs.answer: No. RestaBee focuses on retail counter sales, cake sizing, custom order tracking, billing and cashier shifts. We do not provide factory batch manufacturing or raw ingredient BOM recipe management.

faqs.question: Can staff accept UPI QR code payments at the counter?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cashiers can present a dynamic UPI QR code on the POS screen or print a payment QR code directly on the customer bill for fast digital payments.

faqs.question: How do managers reconcile cash at the end of a shift?
faqs.answer: Cashiers perform a blind cash count at shift close. The manager compares physical cash against expected register totals to verify accuracy.
